extracted.name: Sparkling Champagne Sangria
extracted.description: A crowd-pleasing bubbly, fruity white sangria that is perfect for any occasion!
ingredient_lines: 1 750ml bottle sweet white wine (I use Riesling)
instruction_lines: Place all fruit and orange juice in a large pitcher or bowl, add wine and allow to sit in the refrigerator for 3 – 24 hours. Right before serving, add champagne.
Taste; if you’d like it to be sweeter, add 1/4 cup granulated sugar, honey, or agave. Serve and enjoy!
